_meta.name: scale_reliability
_meta.description: Scale reliability of a six-item engagement battery on battery.pulse (bat_energy, bat_proud, bat_absorbed, bat_recommend, bat_time_flies, bat_dread; 1-5 ratings on one latent trait): Cronbach's alpha and standardized alpha, McDonald's omega from a one-factor minres fit, the mean inter-item correlation, and per item the corrected item-total r, alpha if deleted, mean and sd, with the inter-item correlation matrix as primary. bat_dread is reverse-worded, so params.reverse with scale_min 1 / scale_max 5 flips it (x' = min + max - x) before the fold; without the flip it would drag alpha down. Here the battery holds together: alpha and omega both land near 0.82 and every alpha if deleted sits below the full-scale alpha, so no item is worth dropping. Omega is null with a warning on 2 items (PULSE_MATRIX_NOT_IDENTIFIED), a Heywood fit (PULSE_MATRIX_HEYWOOD, typical when one measure does not belong with the rest) or an unrepaired non-PSD pairwise input. Streamable and mergeable; no p-values.
